name: DubVision
description:
Previously a duo, legendary Dutch progressive act DubVision has been on a solo mission since 2024, with Victor Leicher steering the ship following the departure of his brother Stephan to focus on fatherhood.

He kicked off 2026 with a bang thanks to his remix of the classic ‘Love Me Again’ by John Newman alongside Third Party. The tune was massive, capturing everything the duo has always done so well: progressive synth patterns, soaring drums, and of course, an emotional vocal fitting of the world’s largest stages. From there, Dubvision only went from strength-to-strength, upping the feels at clubs and festivals from Seoul to Boston and back again. As part of the new HALŌ supergroup with Third Party and Matisse & Sadko, they brought their singular sound to festivals like Tomorrowland, Creamfields and Ultra Japan.
best_known_for: “Progressive house anthem ‘Turn It Around’ and recent hits ‘Anywhere With You’ and ‘Starlight (Keep Me Afloat)’.”
